THE FIELD GUIDE

Good things come
in well-chosen sizes.

No room for a countertop full of maybes? Start with a specific problem, understand your options, and make a decision that fits everyday life.

Find a little more room.

10 PRACTICAL FIELD NOTES

FIELD NOTE / 01◫Measure first. Buy once.
Measuring guides

How to measure counter space for small appliances

A compact appliance needs more than a small base. Measure the room it needs to open, refill and operate before you buy.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 02▤A drawer that finally closes.
Food storage

Food container lid organizers for shallow drawers: what to measure

The rack height is only part of the answer. Your tallest lid decides whether a loaded organizer clears the drawer.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 03▦Less fridge Tetris.
Food storage

How to choose meal-prep containers for a mini fridge

Start with the shelf opening and the outside of the lid, rather than the volume printed on the container.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 04◡Small batches, clearer choices.
Compact cooking

Rice cookers for one person: minimum batch matters

The smallest useful cooker is the one that handles your usual portion, fits your space and is straightforward to clean.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 05◫Full fridge. Empty cupboard.
Comparisons

Stackable vs nesting food containers for small kitchens

Stacking helps when containers are full. Nesting helps when they are empty. Choose for the place where space runs out first.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 06▤Make room for the refill.
Compact cooking

Coffee makers under low cabinets: check more than height

A coffee maker can fit while closed and still be difficult to refill. Map the complete morning routine before picking a model.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 07▦The basket needs room, too.
Compact cooking

Small air fryers: compare the working footprint

Body width and quart capacity cannot tell you whether an air fryer works on your counter. Include drawer movement and a place to set hot parts.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 08◡Work around what is already there.
Measuring guides

Measure under-sink storage around pipes and a garbage disposal

Map the obstacles first. The usable space is rarely a simple rectangle the size of your cabinet.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 09◫Count containers, not promises.
Food storage

Food storage set piece counts: do the lids count?

A large piece count can describe fewer usable containers than you expect. Read the set contents before comparing value.

Read the guide ↗
FIELD NOTE / 10▤Buy for the meals you make.
Measuring guides

A practical small-kitchen buying checklist

Make room for your routine before making room for another appliance. Start with a week of meals and the equipment you already own.

SMALL KITCHEN FIELD GUIDE

A clear reason for every recommendation.

Small Kitchen Field Guide helps US readers think through compact cooking, food storage and kitchen fit. We focus on measurements, everyday access and the trade-offs behind a purchase.

What these guides are

Our launch collection contains editorial checklists and explanations based on published information. It does not contain hands-on product rankings. We have not independently tested products described in these guides. A source link is not a claim that its author endorses us.

How we handle product claims

We distinguish dimensions, manufacturer instructions and opinion. When an exact measurement or operating requirement is unavailable, the answer is to verify it with the manufacturer. We do not invent test results, star ratings or customer testimonials.

How the site earns

Amazon links are paid links. If you make a qualifying purchase through one, we may earn a commission. Category links currently open Amazon search results, where listings and prices can change. They are not a claim that a particular product has been tested or selected as best.

Our counter planner

The planner compares dimensions you enter. It has no manufacturer database and does not determine safe placement. Verify all operating requirements, surface suitability and electrical instructions separately.
